lines.3: 「I changed things up for breakfast today and bought something at the convenience store.」
lines.4: 「Oh!? (Am I finally free from rice balls!?)」
lines.5: 「They had a new rice-ball flavor. We should try it.」
lines.7: 「Don't worry. I bought one for you too.」
lines.10: I was gradually getting used to the hierarchy around here.
